notes.thresholds: Each model keeps the threshold chosen on val during model selection. It is not changed on test.
notes.val_view: val is reported only as a check that these numbers match the model selection results.
notes.test_full: test_full = test_main + test_tail. It contains test_main, so the two views are not independent.
notes.baselines: always_legitimate flags nothing; ach_rule flags every ACH payment.
notes.undefined_values: Precision with no alerts, or recall with no laundering, is written as n/a, never 0.
notes.alert_budget: The top ceil(budget x rows) scores get an alert; ties go to the smaller transaction_id. This is a batch-ranking comparison, not a live threshold.
notes.patterns: HI-Small_Patterns.txt is used for evaluation only. Records are matched to transactions on all 11 raw fields; ambiguous matches are left out.
